reviewVerdict: No confirmed blocking defect found in the scoped candidate; recovery and evidence limits below remain explicit.

verifiedDesign.finding: Actual main invocation closure counts logical llm/llm_failed including subagent call events; main run_start resets versioned run identity, current run_end marks final. Late call events invalidate final. Fresh resume is a new run identity/count rather than recount of retained old events.

Recovery only settles a complete count when task/round ownership, known receipts, latest main run_start and terminal/final agree. A stored running/lost-terminal counter remains unknown lower bound, including synthetic restart aborted; no next Runtime budget is automatically allocated.

Receipt and used_llm_calls are one pure Goal result and one existing SQLite UPDATE. Same-goal reads/updates queue in one JS process; repeated same run+same count returns current Goal without new UPDATE, mismatching count/foreign task/run or missing terminal proof refuses. New receipt only occurs after complete checkpoint persisted.

Task checkpoint writes queue and obtain latest card when executing; final persistence failure returns needs_user while keeping in-memory actual run_end/accounting. Explicit preparation saves actual terminal before settlement or completed finalization.

Completed preparation bypasses new Runtime and can settle/finalize before ordinary exhaustion failure. Exact max uses rules or explicit user confirmation, allowModel=false; this branch never creates Jev engine. Unknown completed legacy also suppresses model completion check and does not fabricate old usage.

Settling guard remains while stop deletes active entry, so another GoalRunner recovery cannot run before old late result settles. Real late result may be saved/charged while paused or abandoned, but aborted loop checks prevent finish/new Runtime after stop. Three concurrent invocations on same runner collapse to one loop.
500 live /300 persisted caps remain. Current accounting run_start anchor is reinserted if otherwise trimmed; accounting comes from run metadata, not summing residual event windows.

Bounded integer0..500/final bool/version/task/run regex normalize into fixed plain records. Receipt arrays bound length500 and reject duplicate run IDs/negative/fraction/out-of-range values. Reserved unprefixed prototype identifiers fail run regex and array receipt representation avoids prototype-key maps.

noncompletedLegacyOrRunningUnknown.reason: Top Continue repeats the same fail-closed decision. No recovery-accounting amendment or explicit unknown-counter acknowledgment operation/button exists. The error asks to confirm local records but UI provides no corresponding repair flow. Abandon/delete/new separate Goal are not same-task recovery.
noncompletedLegacyOrRunningUnknown.classification: Known recovery scope and UX gap, not proof that fail-closed itself is a defective safety decision.

completedLegacy.note: AwaitingBar also offers explicit continue-next-round; that is a separate user-authorized future round, not automatic recovery of an unknown nonterminal invocation or proof of prior usage.

lowerLevelTasksResume.classification: Direct store callers are not the audited GoalDetail flow; do not invent current mounted-UI bypass from unused legacy TaskCanvas.

remainingLimits.detail: New logic protects run_start accounting anchor only. Accepted Chat/tool evidence that falls outside retained head/tail is not generally protected. 700-noise boundary asserts counters/anchor and no extra tool/model, not retention of every accepted marker under pressure. Existing bounded-history accepted-output freshness/loss remains outside this patch; do not claim all critical events retained.

Serial queue is per JS module/process. One UPDATE atomically writes receipt+used, but this review/tests do not prove multiple separate frontend/process writers coordinate via CAS/transaction for Goal read-modify-write.

Parser projects fixed fields from persisted JSON and rejects tested malformed counts/IDs. Tests do not cover arbitrary prototype-backed JS getters/objects; normalizeRecoveryAccounting does not enforce exact own-key/prototype shape. No reachable persisted-JSON regression establishing a blocker was found.
Counts are logical llm/llm_failed events, not all fallback wire attempts or provider billed requests. Independent positive-balance Jev accounting and task-id usage D remain unmodified.

No generic stale-checkpoint freshness fix, no reconstruction of lost live terminal or legacy past costs, no unknown-count manual repair flow; legacy completed may honestly retain stored unknown usage rather than newly counted cost.

Existing artifact final narrow13files137pass/typecheck0 are hash/raw-log checked only. No test/compiler/App/network Provider was executed by reviewer; no full suite/new QA/native/Windows SQLx or release binding is proved.
